decision: Approve the AmbientBackground family direction names and their screen-space semantics under the owner's default delegation.

userStatements.quote: no me preguntes termina todo y luego vemos (aplica las propuestas por defecto). Puedes abrir hasta 3 subagentes que parelilcen trabajo y permanezcan abiertos hasta terminar

the engine supports only one fixed 225° direction, so "existing values only" cannot meet S13. Each family gets an optional direction from a closed set of eight named directions (0°–315° in 45° steps); omitted props keep today's 225° for both, so presets are unchanged; invalid values fall back with a development warning; stories show a non-parallel combination.
AmbientBackground direction names follow visible screen motion (default `up-left` = today's 225° motion).

limits: These names apply to independent AmbientBackground particle families; they do not grant a generic layout or text direction convention.
No change to tokens, dependencies, historical presets or prior approval records is implied.

convention.name: lineDirection
convention.meaning: Screen-space movement direction of the line particle family.
convention.whenToUse: Select the travel direction of the line particle family independently.
convention.avoid: Changing particle density, speed or the direction of other particle families.

convention.name: squareDirection
convention.meaning: Screen-space movement direction of the square particle family.
convention.whenToUse: Select the travel direction of the square particle family independently.
convention.avoid: Changing particle density, speed or the direction of other particle families.
